new_series.title: MasterChef: The Professionals
new_series.synopsis: Six ambitious chefs enter the MasterChef kitchen ready to prove they have what it takes to succeed in the competition. Across two demanding challenges, they’ll need to demonstrate their skills.

new_series.title: Return to Paradise
new_series.synopsis: When an artist is murdered during an avant-garde performance piece for the Dolphin Cove art fair, Mackenzie must use her expertise to find the killer.

new_series.title: The Famous Finish Line
new_series.synopsis: Rick Edwards, Harley Moon Kemp, Mollie Pearce, Molly Rainford and La Voix race in moving podiums across a star-spangled-themed studio to try to win £10,000 for their chosen charity.

new_series.title: Rise of the Rockstar Chef
new_series.synopsis: Marco Pierre White's meteoric rise opening Harvey's and how the unpredictable young genius took fledgling Gordon Ramsay under his wing as a young Heston Blumenthal began his career.

new_series.title: Naturewatch
new_series.synopsis: The team investigates some of nature’s biggest mysteries: where have all the acorns gone? Just how small is Britain’s smallest bird? And why on earth is a group of crows known as a murder?

new_series.title: Politically
new_series.synopsis: David Runciman explores the intertwined events of 1956: the Suez Crisis, the Hungarian revolution the American presidential election.

new_series.title: A Charles Paris Mystery
new_series.synopsis: Charles lands a role as a butler in reality show Murder in the Park, and it’s not long before one of the guests ends up dead.

new_series.title: Arc
new_series.synopsis: Noughties popstar Lucy Green is making her big comeback, but will her problems with addiction threaten it all? Sober companion Tim is hired to get her to rehab… in Arizona.

new_series.title: Limelight
new_series.synopsis: Ten years married and overlooked, Josie has fallen for a charming aid worker she has never met. One private video later, he wants ten grand. Comedy thriller stars Jessica Gunning.

new_series.title: Drama on 4
new_series.synopsis: Emergency response teams battle to keep people safe, as flooding hits a Valleys town. By Siân Owen. Starring Remy Beasley.

new_series.title: Artworks
new_series.synopsis: What happens when an artist’s sight begins to disappear? Sociologist Professor Tom Shakespeare explores how sight loss changes the way artists experience the world and create art.

new_series.title: The Kitchen Cabinet
new_series.synopsis: Jay Rayner hosts a culinary panel show packed full of tasty titbits.

new_series.title: The Naked Week
new_series.synopsis: Andrew Hunter Murray and Jon Holmes return with a bold, audacious take on the week's news.

new_series.title: Understand
new_series.synopsis: Ros Atkins investigates how technology is changing what we value, from friendship and culture to finance and work, and asks whether these changes amount to a crisis.
